name: Henry Cuellar

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: I represent 280 miles of the U.S.-Mexico border.
It also provides, as the gentleman said a few minutes ago, $20 million for body-worn cameras, specifically for CBP and ICE, which are conducting immigration enforcement.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of this bill, but first, I want to thank the chairmen of the subcommittees and the full committee and my ranking member for their leadership.
